This page is not a lesson. It holds one sample of each kind of content a
lesson uses, so that rendering can be checked in every browser engine and by
the automated checks of the site.

## Equations

Inline: the period of a pendulum of length $\ell$ at small amplitude is
$T = 2\pi\sqrt{\ell / g}$.

Display, with a fraction, a root, and Greek letters:

$$
x(t) = A\, e^{-\gamma t} \cos(\omega t),
\qquad
\omega = \sqrt{\omega_0^{2} - \gamma^{2}}.
$$

Aligned steps:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\mathrm{d}E}{\mathrm{d}t}
  &= m v \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}t} + k x \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} \\
  &= v \left( m \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}t} + k x \right) \\
  &= 0.
\end{aligned}
$$

An integral, a sum, and a matrix:

$$
W = \int_{x_0}^{x_1} F(x)\, \mathrm{d}x,
\qquad
p = \sum_{i=1}^{N} m_i v_i,
\qquad
\begin{pmatrix} x_{n+1} \\ v_{n+1} \end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix} 1 & \Delta t \\ -\omega^{2} \Delta t & 1 \end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix} x_n \\ v_n \end{pmatrix}.
$$

## Code

The cell below is executed when the site is built. It imports the function
from the `pbc` package of the repository, so the listing and the output
cannot drift apart.

```{python}
import numpy as np

from pbc.sample import damped_oscillation

t = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0, 5)
for time, position in zip(t, damped_oscillation(t), strict=True):
    print(f"t = {time:.1f} s   x = {position:+.4f} m")
```

## Figure

```{python}
#| label: fig-damped-oscillation
#| fig-cap: "A damped oscillation and its envelope."
#| fig-alt: "Line plot of position against time from 0 to 5 seconds. The position oscillates once per second between an upper and a lower envelope curve that both decay towards zero."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

t = np.linspace(0.0, 5.0, 1001)
envelope = np.exp(-0.5 * t)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.4, 3.6))
ax.plot(t, damped_oscillation(t), color="#00429d", label="position")
ax.plot(t, envelope, color="#93003a", linestyle="--", label="envelope")
ax.plot(t, -envelope, color="#93003a", linestyle="--")
ax.set_xlabel("time (s)")
ax.set_ylabel("position (m)")
ax.legend()
plt.show()
```

## Lesson constructs

These are the constructs of the lesson format, one of each.

A listing included by reference from the package:

```{python}
#| echo: false
from pbc.authoring import excerpt

excerpt(damped_oscillation)
```

Material that the build did not run or check, as a block and inside a
sentence:

::: {.not-verified}
```python
position = damped_oscillation(time)  # a listing nothing executed
```
:::

The oscillation loses [about 39 percent]{.not-verified} of its amplitude per
second.

An exercise with a solution that opens without a script:

::: {.exercise}
What is the position at $t = 0$?

::: {.solution}
The amplitude, because $\cos 0 = 1$ and $e^{0} = 1$:
`{python} f"{damped_oscillation(0.0):.1f}"` m.
